question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage suggests that traditional medical practices are changing and adapting due to the integration of machines and new technologies.
 
• The word **"evolving**" appropriately** describes the concept of gradual development and adaptation over time.**
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 3 is '**evolving**'.
 
• Hence, the correct statement from the passage is** "Nonetheless, it is clear that medical hand practices are evolving to __machines, and these developments have the potential to revolutionize the healthcare industry." **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Evolving"** (विकसित होना): Describes gradual development and adaptation.
 
• **"Diminishing"** (घटाना): Means reducing or becoming less important, which is not the intended meaning.
 
• **"Depleting"** (कम करना): Means using up or reducing in number or quantity, which does not fit the context.
 
• **"Stagnating" **(स्थिर होना): Means ceasing to develop or becoming inactive, which is the opposite of the intended meaning.
